items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: And this is when I first met Leonard Feather, when he first came over.

ctx.x: Well -- so any way, now I'm going to go back a little farther again. I'm going a little -- let's see, when I went to New York to live I worked with Roy Eldridge at the Areadia Ballroom. He had a big band, a good band.

And we left there, we got a small group and we went to -- we went to Kelly's Stables, which was on 51st Street then I believe. And this is when I first met Leonard Feather, when he first came over. And I -- if I'm not mistaken Leonard was married at that time to a piano player. I'm sure he was.
